title: POST /api/settings/event-notifications/test
description: Send a test of a stored rule (rule_id) or of an unsaved draft rule (rule; the edit panel tests before saving). Exactly one of both: 422 for neither (anyOf) and for both (hub check; the codegen subset cannot express "not both"). 404 when rule_id is unknown, 422 notifications.no_target without target. The test goes to every target of the rule and is fired as <ns>_event with test true (rest/event-notifications-test.response.json).
